item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We need a binding, enforceable ban before any company or government builds it.

2. We reject the race to superintelligence. Building it within the next 20 years will cause catastrophe and kill at least a billion people. No laboratory has the right to impose that danger on humanity.

3. Superintelligent AI is not just another technology. If it is built within 20 years, at least a billion people will die. We are working for an international ban with rigorous monitoring and meaningful penalties.

### (b) Newsletter opening

If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We say this plainly because euphemism is dangerous when so many lives are at stake. Such systems will outthink, outmaneuver, and overpower every institution meant to control them. No company, government, or laboratory can justify taking that risk on everyone’s behalf. We are working for a binding ban on superintelligence, backed by enforceable international rules, rigorous monitoring, and meaningful penalties. The choice before us is not how to win a race to build it, but how to stop that race before it ends in mass death.
